newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey likely to issue its first Italy lira bond.
newsitem.headline: Turkey likely to issue its first Italy lira bond.

text.p: Turkey is expected to issue its first Italian lira-denominated bonds in early 1997, banking sources said.
They said the country had mandated Chase Manhattan for the issue, which is expected in late February or early March.
Bankers also said Turkey was likely to launch a mark-denominated Eurobond soon.
Turkish officials declined to give any further details.
"Turkey might revise its borrowing plans in line with any new development regarding its credit rating," said a banker.
A team from Moody's, which placed Turkey in early January on review for possible downgrade, will begin its studies on Monday for the assessment of the Turkish economy.
